# Import Packages

```{r}
library(DBI)        # dbConnect / dbGetQuery / dbListTables  (≈ sqlalchemy)
library(odbc)       # ODBC driver layer                        (≈ pyodbc)
library(dplyr)      # group_by / summarise / mutate           (≈ pandas)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)  # floor_date()                            (≈ pd.Grouper freq="M")
library(ggplot2)    # plotting                                (≈ matplotlib + seaborn)
```

# Connect to Server

```{r}
readRenviron(".env")

con <- dbConnect(
  odbc::odbc(),
  Driver   = "ODBC Driver 18 for SQL Server",
  Server   = Sys.getenv("SQL_HOST"),   # host,port in one string
  Database = "AdventureWorksDW2025",
  UID      = Sys.getenv("SQL_USER"),
  PWD      = Sys.getenv("SQL_PASSWORD"),
  TrustServerCertificate = "yes",
  timeout  = 5
)

```

# Exploratory Data Analysis

## List All Tables

```{r}
# Query base user tables directly from the database catalog
user_tables <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT TABLE_NAME 
  FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES 
  WHERE TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'
")$TABLE_NAME

print(user_tables)
```

## List All Views

```{r}
# Query views directly from the database catalog
views <- dbGetQuery(con, "
  SELECT * 
  FROM sys.views
")$name

print(views)
```

## Inspect Tables

### FactInternetSales

```{r}
df <- dbReadTable(con, "FactInternetSales")

df_info <- function(df) {
  data.frame(
    column   = names(df),
    non_null = vapply(df, function(x) sum(!is.na(x)), integer(1)),
    dtype    = vapply(df, function(x) class(x)[1], character(1)),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}

df_info(df)          # ≈ df.info()
colSums(is.na(df))   # ≈ df.isnull().sum()
sum(duplicated(df))  # ≈ df.duplicated().sum()
```

## Join & Plot

```{r}
# 1. Re-run the SQL query to get the combined sales data
sql_query <- "
SELECT p.EnglishProductName AS ProductName,
       'Internet' AS SalesChannel,
       f.OrderDate, f.SalesAmount
FROM FactInternetSales f
JOIN DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
UNION ALL
SELECT p.EnglishProductName AS ProductName,
       'Reseller' AS SalesChannel,
       f.OrderDate, f.SalesAmount
FROM FactResellerSales f
JOIN DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
"

df <- dbGetQuery(con, sql_query)

# 2. Summarize by Month and SalesChannel
monthly <- df |>
  mutate(Month = floor_date(as.Date(OrderDate), "month")) |>
  summarise(SalesAmount = sum(SalesAmount), .by = c(Month, SalesChannel))

# 3. Filter for the overlapping date range (Jan 2011 to Nov 2013)
monthly_overlap <- monthly |>
  filter(Month >= as.Date("2011-01-01") & Month <= as.Date("2013-11-01"))

# 4. Plot
ggplot(monthly_overlap, aes(x = Month, y = SalesAmount, color = SalesChannel)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Internet" = "#4C72B0", "Reseller" = "#DD8452")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::dollar) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly Sales by Channel (Overlapping Period)",
    subtitle = "Active window: Jan 2011 – Nov 2013",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Sales Amount"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
